# Key-Value List

Semantic description list (<dl>) for record details: label and value pairs in stacked, side-by-side or grid layout.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_KEY_VALUE_LIST` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/keyValueList` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |

Each query row renders one label/value pair. Typical source: an UNPIVOT of the current record or a query returning one row per attribute.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Name of the property, for example Customer. |
| `value` | Value | sessionStateValue |  |  | Property value. Empty values show the Empty Text. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional Font APEX icon class shown before the label, for example fa-user. |
| `emptyText` | Empty Text | text |  | `-` | Text shown when a value is null. |
| `layout` | Layout | selectList (`inline`, `stacked`, `grid`) | yes | `inline` | Inline puts label and value side by side (stacks on phones). Grid places pairs in responsive columns. |
| `dividers` | Show Dividers | yesNo |  | `Y` | Draw a line between pairs. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/key-value-list/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_key_value_list.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
